verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents an Export API that runs asynchronous export jobs and returns a download URL to a zip/pdf of the exported data. Its REST API returns JSON, which offers a programmatic way to pull records out. The evidence does not show that exports cover all data, does not name the file format inside the zip, and gives no off-boarding or migration path. Missing for 10: confirmation that all data types are exportable, explicit open file formats (e.g. CSV/JSON) for exports, documented account exit/migration process, independent hands-on corroboration.
